name: Jonnie and Lily's Diner
note: Dining room: yellow walls with wooden-spoon art, chalkboard specials, wood tables and chairs, front window onto Okanagan St with hanging plants. New Google Maps uploads; several other good room shots also exist (gm5/6/11).

name: King's Vegetarian Food
note: Food truck at the farmers market: white trailer with service window, "King's Vegetarian Food" name banner readable, menu boards (Won Ton Soup, Steamed Bun, Basil Cake), other market stalls behind. Truck-with-name counts as storefront; slightly busy with menu boards.

name: Mad Mango Cafe
note: Wide storefront: orange "MAD MANGO CAFÉ Ltd" sign fully readable, glass front with OPEN neon and diners at the window counter, #551 door. Landscape Google Maps upload the first pass did not have.

name: Press'd Sandwich Shop
note: Dining room: green banquette with white tables and steel chairs, colourful "It's all good" veggie mural, framed green posters on white brick. Found in the Google Maps Vibe tab.

name: Streats Harvey Kitchen
note: Dining room: big graffiti "Kitchen" mural with a taco character over slatted-wood banquette, butcher-block tables, yellow and green chairs, pendant lights.

name: TAMM Mexican Restaurant
note: Dining room: Mexican flags draped on the wall with a "Mi Casa es Su Casa" plaque, red and green neon cactus signs on dark stone, tables and chairs in front. Slightly soft but clear atmosphere. Found in the Google Maps Vibe tab.

name: Tak-Oh
note: The green and white Tak-Oh food truck with its TAK-OH name panel readable, open serving window with the cook, chalk menu, red umbrella; top of a taco box at the bottom edge.

name: Cherry Bomb Sandwiches
note: The Cherry Bomb! Sandwiches food truck (trailer) side-on, name and cherry artwork fully readable, service window open, patio chairs in front. Own Instagram post, April 2026.

name: Same Same But Different Thai Food
note: The white Same Same But Different Thai Food trailer with its painted awning sign and lettering readable, parked beside Sunview Market with fall trees and barrels. Truck is on the right; centre of the strip is the market porch.

name: Campo Marina
note: Dusk exterior: white stucco building with lit CAMPO lettering over the arched entrance, glowing lamps, and diners on the covered patio at right. Name readable in the strip. Source is 1328px wide (TripAdvisor hero photo, 2016).

name: THE BEAST BBQ AND SMOKE SHACK
note: The green food truck with 'The Beast BBQ Smoke Shack' readable, Coors umbrella, and outdoor tables and chairs, with Osoyoos hills behind. A cook and a diner are small in frame, not the subject. Owner's own Facebook Page photo. Facebook signed URL (oe= param) expires; the file in chosen/ is the saved copy.

name: Tantuni Turkish Cuisine
source_page: Google Maps: Tantuni Turkish Cuisine, 130 Westminster Ave W
note: Head-on storefront (a new Google upload): big 'TANTUNI Turkish Cuisine' sign box over grey block walls, with yellow and grey diagonal stripes, black window awnings and OPEN signs in the windows. Name clearly readable. The sign is prominent, but the facade and windows fill the rest of the strip.

name: Red Robin Vernon
source_page: Google Maps listing "Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews", 5601 Anderson Way #400 (customer photo of this location)
note: Busy dining room: exposed yellow ducts, pendant lights, booths with diners, the open kitchen with "Gourmet" mural and the Red Robin mascot statue on the left. People are small in the frame (no faces dominant).

name: Murray's Pizza & Pasta
note: Storefront cut out of the Google 360 pano (stitched across the wrap): strip shows the big red MURRAY'S PIZZA & PASTA awning, the window graphics around the door and shrubs. Name clearly readable, no cars or people in the strip. Slightly soft (pano source).

name: Fusion Food Lounge
note: Storefront sign "FUSION FOOD LOUNGE" on dark cladding with the soffit below. Weak: the strip is essentially the sign; windows/door are below it (portrait original). Facebook page has only a logo, promo graphics and pizza close-ups.

name: Halfmoon Pizzeria + Donair
note: Storefront at an angle: channel-letter sign "half moon pizz…" with the pizza-shaped Os, and a "DIY Take 'N' Bake & Frozen Pizza AVAILABLE NOW!" banner. Weak: the end of "pizzeria" and the banner run off the right edge. Instagram is promo graphics only.

name: Hot Pot Grill Authentic Indian Cuisine
note: Storefront at 180/182 Asher Rd: red "HOT POT" street cart with clay pots, window poster "Authentic Indian Cuisine / Hot Pot Grill", glass door with Welcome / hours decal, chalkboard sign. Weak: plain stucco wall and door take much of the strip, no room visible.

name: New York Fries Orchard Park
note: Orchard Park food-court counter: menu light-boxes, NYF Poutinerie wood panel, marble wall. Weak: the big newyorkfries letters sit at the very top of the photo, so the strip cuts off their tops (name half-readable); no other location photo exists.

name: Pizza 64 (Kelowna)
note: Dusk storefront: lit windows showing the yellow-walled interior with pendant lights, Pizza 64 logo and part of the PIZZA lettering above. Weak: angled shot, the big sign is cut at the top and a Cheesecake Factory poster fills the right window.

name: PrimeTime Donair & Poutine
note: Order counter: red/white tiled room with four digital menu boards over the counter, staff member behind it, customers at the till on the right. Weak: menu boards dominate the top of the strip; no seating area shown.

name: Ramen Arashi Kelowna
note: Open kitchen and bar counter seen through the glass: cook at the pass, steel shelving, wooden counter tops. Weak: plain counter view, cook's face visible (small, not the subject), menu posters cut at the top. Storefront photo only gives the sign or the doorway in the strip.

name: Red Swan Pizza - Kelowna East
note: Night shot of the lit "Red Swan Pizza" fascia sign, name fully readable. Weak: strip is essentially the sign on a beige wall; the only other photo of this location adds the door between two parked cars. Rest are pizza boxes and a promo graphic.

name: Tropic Isle Mart
note: Storefront: the big 'Tropic Isle mart - A taste of the tropics!' sign on the yellow wall; 3:1 strip is essentially just the sign. Weak (sign-only) but name fully readable. Instagram/Facebook only have product shots and promo graphics; no interior or counter photo exists.

name: White Spot Kelowna Airport
note: Sunny terminal atrium seating: round wooden table and chairs among indoor trees and tall windows, airport directory sign (White Spot / Skyway Cafe and Bar) top-left. Weak: may be shared atrium seating rather than the restaurant proper; White Spot logo is cut at the top of the 3:1 strip.

name: Bullies Pizza
note: Front of the shop under the strip-mall porch: window with PIZZA and OPEN neon, red bistro chairs and tables outside, two glass doors and a planter. Name sign is above the strip (not readable); doors take up much of the right half.

name: Edo Japan
source_page: Google Maps: Edo Japan, 300 Riverside Dr #126
note: Storefront of this location: lit 'Edo Japan / Grill / Sushi' sign over the dark timber canopy, with the tops of the shop windows. Weak: the top of the 'Edo' letters is clipped by the original frame, and the canopy takes up a lot of the strip. I cropped above the parked cars, which fill the bottom of the original.

name: Penticton Pizza
source_page: Google Maps: Penticton Pizza, 723 Main St #102
note: Storefront at an angle: red, white and green awning reading 'PENTICTON PIZZA ... Hot & Fresh Pizza by Slice ... 250-492-7603' over the brick front, with the neighbouring 'Sunrise Business Centre' and sky at left. Weak: the awning text and phone number dominate. TripAdvisor has only pizza-box shots and a logo.

name: Quesada Burritos & Tacos
source_page: Google Maps: Quesada Burritos & Tacos, 290 Riverside Dr #166
note: Storefront of this location: big red 'Quesada Burritos & Tacos' sign over a timber canopy, with the neighbouring Booster Juice sign at right. Weak: the strip is mostly sign, canopy and cloudy sky, a construction crane shows at the top right, and only the tops of the windows show.

name: Terry's Comfort Food
source_page: Google Maps: Terry's Comfort Food With Attitude - Pita Nutso fine dining, 2156 Main St
note: Storefront fascia: 'Terry's comfort food with attitude / Breakfast and Lunch' sign, with the brick front, string lights and the top of the lit OPEN window below. Weak: the sign dominates the strip, and the shared 'Pita Nutso' sign is at the right edge. TripAdvisor has only plates of food.

name: Pizza Gratta
source_page: Google Maps listing "Pizza Gratta", 139 Main St #110 (SilverStar village)
note: Carved "Pizza Gratta" hanging sign on the yellow/white village building with the deck railing and blue sky; the name is readable but the strip is mostly sign, railing and sky (no room or food). Other options were a staff portrait (face main subject), dough and single-slice close-ups.

name: Summerland Indian Bistro & Pizza
source_page: Google Maps listing "Summerland Indian Bistro & Pizza", 9915 Main St
note: Storefront: blue "Summerland Indian Bistro & Pizza" sign with poster-covered windows below; name readable, but the strip is mostly sign and window posters. Google gallery has only 9 photos (no interior).

name: Diner On Six
source_page: Google Maps listing "Diner On Six", 2511 BC-6
note: Exterior: building with lit "Diner on Six" wall sign and marquee "Diner on Six / Our family welcomes yours", patio tables in front; parked cars on the right and an orange bollard. Interior alternative (booth with wood wall, raw/diner-on-six/b/F27.jpg) was plainer.

name: Ogopogo Concessions
note: Their "mini donuts" trailer with Ogopogo logo, customers at the window, a neighbouring burger truck on the left and their "Mac & Cheese" stand on the right at a fair. Name readable on the trailer; a water tote intrudes on the right edge and the source is slightly soft.

name: Pho Fusion
source_page: Google Maps listing "Pho Fusion Vietnamese Cuisine", 5100 Anderson Way
note: Straight-on brick storefront: "Pho Fusion Vietnamese Cuisine" letters above the black awning; strip is mostly sign, brick and awning. Interior shots exist (raw/pho-fusion/b/F5.jpg) but are dominated by a booth back and an empty room.

name: Rice Box
source_page: Google Maps listing "The Rice Box", 3104 C 27 St
note: Lit "The Rice Box - Asian Fusion Kitchen" sign over the storefront; the 3:1 strip is essentially just the sign. Remaining gallery photos are takeout boxes, menus and a washroom.

name: barBURRITO
note: Google Maps customer photo of the Vernon counter: strip shows the stainless kitchen line, sneeze-guard counter with a staff member's gloved hands (face out of frame), takeout containers and the Get Saucy / Sauces signs; bottom edge of the menu screens at top. Weak: it reads as a fast-food service counter, partly signage. The only storefront (900px wide, mostly parking lot) and the red-wall kitchen shot (900px) are too small.

name: Beef Broccoli
note: Storefront: strip shows the BeefBroccoli sign, the grey metal awning and the tops of the windows with an OPEN sign. Weak: left third is a tree and blue sky, and the windows/door are cut at the bottom. Best available; landscape storefront is dominated by the neighbour's decals and a mailbox.

name: Ginza Sushi West Kelowna
note: Dining room from a booth: strip shows dark wood tables and leather chairs, a partition, the glass entrance with ENTRANCE/EXIT sign and the reversed Ginza window decal. Weak: entrance door and a booth back take up a lot of the strip; only 1320px wide. Alternative chosen/ginza-sushi-west-kelowna_sushibar.jpg shows the sushi bar with paper lanterns and noren curtains but is motion-blurred.

name: Kaiso Japanese and Thai Cuisine
note: Storefront cut out of the 9424px Google 360 pano (not the distorted whole pano): strip shows the red KAISO / Japanese & Thai Cuisine sign, the canopy and the windows with Japanese art posters and unit 307 door. Weak: the right half is the neighbouring H&R Block, slight pano curvature, and the door shows a CLOSED sign (probably just off-hours).

name: Smoke Shack Deli
note: Storefront: strip is mostly the SMOKE SHACK DELI sign over the top of the windows (unit 214), with the neighbouring Villages Pizza logo just at the right edge. Weak: it's essentially a sign; the portrait photo can't show the windows and patio tables in a 3:1 strip. Alternative chosen/smoke-shack-deli_counter.jpg shows the order counter with a framed Ali photo, hot-dog roller and till.
